messages:
Alex: Heads up — planning the Launchpad pilot in ap-northeast-8 (new AWS region). We need GPU entitlements for p5 and g5 + increased ENI/NAT gateway IPs across two accounts. Target: 12 p5 instances and 24 g5 instances initially, plus burst capacity for the first week. Timeline: ramp next Monday.

Priya: Do you have the account IDs, VPC names, and a quick justification we can paste into AWS? AWS often blocks p5 by default in new regions.

Alex: Account IDs: 111122223333 (launchpad-prod), 444455556666 (launchpad-staging). VPCs: launchpad-prod-vpc, launchpad-staging-vpc. Justification: low-latency interactive demos + prod pilot, need dedicated inference capacity for customers. Expected 24/7 baseline with short peak bursts (roughly 200 GPU-hours/day at peak week 1).

Marta: Ok. For networking: what are your subnet IP plans? ENI limits are usually the blocker. Recommend requesting ENI ceiling -> 200 for prod account, 100 for staging; also ask for Elastic IPs / NAT GW allocation bump (we'll likely need 10 extra EIPs).

Sam: Cost question — do we plan reserved commits or on-demand? Suggest start with a small reserved pool for predictable latency, then auto-scale. Also I can open the AWS Support case if you want.

Alex: Please open the case, Sam. I'll provide the workload calc. We want p5s for the lowest latency, fallback to p4d for shortfall.

aws-quota-bot: Quota request submitted by Sam. Case #CASE-8473621 created. Current reported limits: p5: 0, g5: 8, ENI: 30 (prod account).

Priya: I'll reach out to our TAM and get a priority escalation if needed. Marta — can you draft a short network diagram and the security/KMS notes to attach to the ticket?

Marta: On it. Can you confirm expected peak network throughput and number of subnets per AZ? Need those to justify ENI and ENI-per-instance requests.

Alex: Peak network per GPU ~10 Gbps, planning 3 subnets / AZ for prod. If p5 unavailable, we want p4d fallbacks + add 12 more g5s in the same region if possible. Also please indicate that this is a constrained pilot with revenue impact; that usually helps approvals.

Ciara: Please cc security@redwood when you update the ticket — KMS/HSM plan must be reviewed for the private key handling on inference nodes. Also flag finance for a potential Dedicated commit if we move off on-demand — they'll need an estimate. :eyes:

Alex: @Ciara noted — will attach KMS plan and cost estimate to CASE-8473621. Thanks :thumbsup:

Sam: I'll watch the case and ping the TAM. If we don't get p5 quota in 72h we'll fallback to p4d + temporary g5 burst. Tracking in the case and will post updates here.

(automated): next steps assigned: Marta -> network diagram + security notes; Sam -> AWS TAM follow-up; Alex -> workload numbers and cost estimate.
